llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文研究SLM制造的钴铬合金与陶瓷的结合强度，与用户的骨科植入物应力屏蔽研究方向不直接相关。
llm.why_not_core: No porous structure for stiffness matching, no fatigue testing, no osseointegration or surface morphology analysis.

summary_zh.motivation: 研究多次烧结对SLM钴铬合金与陶瓷结合强度的影响
summary_zh.method: 对SLM制备的Co-Cr合金进行不同次数的烧结，测试其与陶瓷的结合强度
summary_zh.result: 多次烧结显著影响结合强度，存在最优烧结次数
summary_zh.validation: 通过剪切强度测试验证

summary_en.motivation: To investigate the effect of multiple firing cycles on the metal-ceramic bond strength of Co-Cr alloy fabricated by selective laser melting.
summary_en.method: Co-Cr alloy specimens were fabricated by SLM and subjected to different numbers of firing cycles, followed by bond strength testing.
summary_en.result: The bond strength was significantly affected by the number of firings, with an optimal range identified.
summary_en.validation: Shear bond strength tests were conducted.
